(黃連 (huánglián) is its envoy; it is incompatible with 細辛 (xìxīn), 芍藥 (sháoyào), and the five 參 (shēn); it fears 大黃 (dàhuáng).)

The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 藜蘆 (lílú), flavor acrid, cold. It governs gu-poison and cough and retching (蠱毒咳逆), diarrhea and intestinal  (lì), head ulcers, scabies, itching, and malignant sores (頭瘍疥瘙惡瘡), and kills the various worms (殺諸蟲)...
